issue_context.title: Ability to easy control of ~/.ansible directory location
issue_context.body:
### Summary

I want to control ~/.ansible directory location but it's ridiculously complex. My main motivation is clean and controllable $HOME directory.

Currently I have to setup around 24 environment variables to make it possible. And even if achieve it, it is not guaranteed that behavior will not be changed in the future or new plugin will not require to fix the path.

I'm aware of previous attempts to adopt XDG:
- https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/52354
- https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/68587

I'm partially agree your points against XDG. For me personally it's not XDG_CONFIG, it should be XDG_DATA... or XDG_CACHE.

I suggest to create **one** variable which will be base prefix of rest ~**24** variables which refers to ~/.ansible directory. This variable may not have any relations with XDG at all but allow to get control to users and get rid of polluted $HOMEs.

```yaml
BASE_PREFIX:
  default: ~/.ansible
COLLECTIONS_PATHS:
  default: {{BASE_PREFIX}}/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
```

I offer my help to work on PR as well if you will not be against of this idea.

Feature Idea

core
